response_contract: ArtifactReadResult plus preparation_id, part, approval_id, approval_digest; sha256 and size cover complete prepared bytes, data_base64 covers only requested chunk
behavior: Only existing live preparation and original command/lease generation are accepted
Full cached bytes are checked against exact proposal digest and size before each chunk
Durable artifact reservation actor/session/run/command/project and exact durable approval binding are revalidated
Denied/expired approval, lost bundle, cancelled/completed control, replaced lease or revoked scope returns no bytes
Reuses inert artifact chunk validation; no source refetch, source fallback, publication or approval mutation
Client must assemble all chunks, verify total size and full SHA against exact original/projection proposal, then offer publication
focused_tests: Complete original and projection chunks assemble to exact size/SHA and match later published bytes
Approval remains pending and command/budget remain unchanged during review
Actual registered RPC and generated DTO validation
Forged principal/content fields and oversized/noninteger bounds rejected
Cross-profile foreign bundle and stolen-session RPC denied
Published, cancelled, replaced-lease, expired-bundle and denied-approval states expose no bytes
Missing projection, lost project grant and overrun offsets denied
Synthetic HTTP request count remains exactly2; review never dispatches
scope_limits: Existing gateway account pin and opaque upstream retry/cost limitations unchanged
Frontend assembly/rendering remains frontend-owned; backend supplies exact bounded bytes and verification metadata
No Git staging/commits or root journal/build-plan edits
